# Cops

<!-- Generated by `bin/docs`. Do not edit by hand. -->

Every cop lives under the `Callbacksystems/` namespace and ships enabled. Each one links to its source, where an `@example` block contrasts the code it rejects with the code it asks for, and `config/default.yml` holds its options and default scope.
